newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom says Saleh is new chairman.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom says Saleh is new chairman.

text.p: The parent companies of Malaysian car maker Proton Bhd said on Thursday they have appointed Saleh Sulong as their new chairman.
The announcement was made by a master of ceremonies before he introduced Saleh, who had been deputy chairman of the DRB-Hicom group, at a news conference.
Saleh replaces Yahaya Ahmad, who was killed on Monday in a helicopter crash.
Analysts had tagged Saleh as the most likely successor to Yahaya, as he was the next in rank and had worked closely with the late industrialist for nearly 20 years.
Yahaya and his associates indirectly own around 65 percent of the DRB-Hicom group, which includes vehicle assembler Diversified Resources Bhd (DRB) and Hicom Holdings Bhd.
